北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗但寒冷，体感 -4℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, but feels like -4℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感 4℃。外出别忘加件外套。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool in Cixi, feels like 4℃. Don't forget a jacket when going out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天有风，体感 6℃。注意防风，别着凉了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and breezy in Shanghai, feels like 6℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 21℃。享受这温暖舒适的一天吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 21℃. Enjoy this lovely day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗温暖，气温 22℃。多出去走走，感受阳光。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and warm in Shenzhen at 22℃. Get out and enjoy the sunshine.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有凉意，体感 4℃。记得多穿些，暖和最重要。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and chilly in Hangzhou, feels like 4℃. Remember to wear more layers.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云寒凉，体感 3℃。外出务必穿暖和，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold in Nanjing, feels like 3℃. Dress warmly when heading out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 12℃。早晚温差大，别忘了添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, 12℃. Mind the temperature difference, add layers.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云微凉，体感 6℃。外出记得穿外套，小心着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and cool in Wuhan, feels like 6℃. Wear a jacket when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天寒冷，体感 3℃，湿度低。记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold in Xi'an, feels like 3℃. Low humidity, remember to hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天微湿，气温 11℃。出门带伞，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and damp in Chongqing, 11℃. Bring an umbrella, stay dry.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴极寒，体感 -20℃。全副武装，注意防冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but extremely cold in Harbin, feels like -20℃. Dress warmly, prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗寒冷，体感 -15℃。多穿厚衣，暖暖和和出门。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and cold in Shenyang, feels like -15℃. Wear thick clothes, stay warm.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温 19℃。风力稍大，注意防晒补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant in Kunming, 19℃. It's windy, mind sun protection and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天风大，体感 11℃。出门注意防风，小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and windy in Xiamen, feels like 11℃. Watch out for wind, stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -1℃。风大体感寒，记得多加衣服。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy in Qingdao, feels like -1℃. It's windy and cold, dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云寒冷，体感 -7℃。出门包裹严实，注意防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold in Dalian, feels like -7℃. Bundle up tightly when going out.
